attchmntText: Swaraj Suiting Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 14, 2026, titled "Strong Growth Continues".
voiceSummary: Swaraj Suiting Limited filed press release regarding consolidated and standalone unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results. Standalone revenue from operations grew 72.3% year on year to INR 2,195.2 Mn in Q2 FY27 and 97.3% to INR 4,028.9 Mn in H1 FY27. Net profit increased 94.5% to INR 172.9 Mn in Q2 FY27 and 96.9% to INR 335.1 Mn in H1 FY27. Earnings per share stood at INR 6.55 in Q2 FY27 and INR 12.69 in H1 FY27. The company plans to commence commercial production of its spinning division expansion by Q1 FY28. Finished fabric manufacturing capacity is expected to increase by approximately 30 Mn Mtrs by Q4 FY28. The company aims to meet up to 50% of electricity requirements through renewable energy by the end of FY28.

attchmntText: Submission of Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Swaraj Suiting Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by Crisil Ratings Limited. The report covers the utilization of proceeds from a preferential issue of equity shares and convertible warrants totaling Rs 226.48 crore. During the quarter, utilization towards working capital exceeded the revised allocation by Rs 3.23 crore from equity proceeds and Rs 4.80 crore from warrant proceeds. This reduced funds available for capital expenditure. The company obtained shareholder approval on September 30, 2026, for ratifying this excess utilization. The shortfall in capital expenditure funding is met from internal accruals. No other material deviations were observed. The company confirmed that the current market price of Rs 323.45 per share remains above the warrant conversion price of Rs 236 per share.

attchmntText: Swaraj Suiting Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Swaraj Suiting Limited has approved its standalone unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results during a meeting held on November 14, 2026. For the half-year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 40,288.82 lakhs. Profit before tax stood at 4,806.76 lakhs. Profit for the period was 3,345.40 lakhs. Basic earnings per share were 12.69. Diluted earnings per share were 10.60. Total assets as at September 30, 2026, were 96,414.72 lakhs. Paid-up equity share capital was 2,641.83 lakhs. Net cash flow from operating activities for the half-year was 4,058.75 lakhs. Net cash used in investing activities was 6,637.60 lakhs. Net cash from financing activities was 2,293.88 lakhs. Cash and cash equivalents at the end of the period were 772.74 lakhs.

attchmntText: Swaraj Suiting Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Swaraj Suiting Limited filed clarifications regarding the proposed preferential issue and warrant conversion for the Extra-Ordinary General Meeting held on October 24, 2026. The company proposes allotting equity shares to Clarus Capital I, Kritagyata Trust, and Emerge Capital Opportunities Scheme. Additionally, shares are proposed for allotment upon conversion of warrants to eighty-one non-promoter identified persons, including Anns Capital Private Limited and RNR Wealth Management Private Limited. The total post-issue shareholding for these allottees is projected at 11.834 percent for the first group and 12.861 percent for the second group. All proposed allottees remain classified as non-promoters. There will be no change in the management or control of the company. The valuation report dated September 24, 2026, and its addendum dated October 19, 2026, confirm no change in valuation. These matters are subject to shareholder approval.

attchmntText: Swaraj Suiting Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the allotment of 4,65,000 equity shares pursuant to the conversion of warrants at its Board Meeting held today i.e. October 30, 2026.
